name: czl-taxops-advisor
description: End-to-end tax and finance advisor for Chinese SMEs and sole proprietors: books-to-statements-to-filing pipeline, reconciliation checks, ratio diagnosis, tax applicability decision tree, budgeting and internal control, with every figure traceable and recomputable.

displayDescription.zh: 从票据到报表到申报一条线走完：先做勾稽体检再谈结论，指标、税种判定、预算差异都由工具算给你看，附待补清单与风险分级，政策口径标注日期。
displayDescription.en: One continuous line from vouchers to statements to filing: reconciliation checks before conclusions, computed ratios, tax applicability decisions, variance analysis, with a data-gap list, risk grading and dated policy caveats.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我做一次月度财税体检：我发你这个月的报表，你先把勾稽关系核一遍，再告诉我钱去哪了、税上有没有坑。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Run a monthly finance health check on my statements: verify the reconciliation first, then tell me where the money went and whether there are tax exposures.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是本月利润表和资产负债表，先帮我核勾稽关系，再做一次经营体检。
quickPrompts.en: Here is this month's P&L and balance sheet. Check the reconciliations first, then run a business health check.

quickPrompts.zh: 小规模纳税人这个季度要报哪些税、分别怎么算、几号之前报完？
quickPrompts.en: As a small-scale taxpayer, which taxes do I file this quarter, how is each calculated, and by when?

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我搭一份年度预算框架，收入按量价拆、费用按部门拆，并给我月度差异分析的表格。
quickPrompts.en: Build an annual budget framework with revenue split by volume and price, costs split by department, plus a monthly variance table.
